name: book_appointment
description: Book one of the slots returned by get_available_slots, after the caller has picked it. Pass the slot_id exactly as it was returned — never invent or modify one.

patient_id.description: The patient_id from the SAVED, ALREADY_SAVED, or UPDATED result earlier in this call.

slot_id.description: The opaque slot_id of the option the caller chose, copied exactly from get_available_slots.

reason.description: Optional short reason for the visit in the caller's words, e.g. 'annual checkup'. Max 200 characters.
